card.name: Adverse-effect terms in warning sections
card.fires_on: The word or punctuation right after an adverse-event term in warnings, such as "reactions" after "cardiac adverse" or "in" after "suicidality". It marks the spot where the risk phrase is complete and a qualifier follows.

modes.description: The end of a complication word or a list comma within a warning.
